findings: Temperature, accelerometer, magnetometer and light each verified with three samples in the builtin sequence.

Final temperature transfer completed and actual disconnect event arrived after 4519 ms, but reconnect disconnected during info service discovery. Final temperature execution and measurement remain unverified.
Separate diagnosis timed out during info service discovery; the quick plan then failed before any installation-mode request.

After physical reset, temperature mode 1 was confirmed and quick round trip passed. Starting builtin after that completed run reproduced the disconnect-event timeout on its first mode-0 request, before flashing. Initial mode 1 and temperature identity are captured.

Separate diagnosis after timeout confirmed mode 0 and unchanged temperature identity; explicit quick rerun restored temperature mode 1 and three samples. This is recovery by the operator, not an automatic-recovery test.
Sensor-specific independent startup for accelerometer, magnetometer and light remains untested. They were verified as continuous transitions in the first sequence.

afterUserReset.userReport: Power remained on; user pressed reset.
